'''Cyndra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] who served as a member of the [[Anti-Republic Liberation Front]]. She, along with [[Paak]], survived and fled from the [[Kidnap attempt on Serenno|Duel on Serenno]], a failed kidnapping attempt on [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]]. Later, on orders from [[Hetton]], she forcefully led "[[Darth Zannah/Legends|Rainah]]" to her leader. It was revealed in their ride to [[Hetton's great mansion|Hetton's mansion]] that at one point she was romantically involved with [[Kelad'den]].

During the meeting with Hetton, Darth Zannah used Sith sorcery on Cyndra which drove her insane, seeing a vision of Kelad'den among other things. After clawing her eyes out, she suffered a seizure, which left her in a permanent [[Persistent vegetative state|catatonic state]] and her death at the hands of Darth Zannah.
